sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat('select partno.varPartNo as partNo,
       replace(replace(parttxt.varDescription, CHAR(10),''''),CHAR(13),'''') as Description,
       parttxt.varUserField1 as ident,
       invID.varInventoryID as ItemID,
       categorytbl.varCategory as category,
       subcategorytbl.varCategory as subcategory,
       invType.varInventoryType as InventoryType,
       invLocationtxt.varLocationName as LocationName,
       invLocation.varBinShelf as BinShelf,
       invLocation.intMinOnHand as MinOnHand,
       invLocation.intMaxOnHand as MaxOnHand,
       invLocation.intQtyOnHand as QtyOnHand,
       invLocation.intIssued as Issued,
       invLocation.intInTransitInbound as TransitInBound,
       invLocation.intReserved as Reserved,
       invLocation.intInKit as InKit,
       invLocation.intTotal as Total,
       invLocation.intInTransitOutbound as InTransitOutBound,
       invLocation.intOnPurchaseOrder as OnPurchaseOrder
from [dbo].[tblInventory] partno,
     [dbo].[tblInventoryText] parttxt,
     [dbo].[tblInventoryID] invID,
     [dbo].[tblCategoryText] categorytbl,
     [dbo].[tblCategoryText] subcategorytbl,
     [dbo].[tblInventoryTypeText] invType,
     [dbo].[tblInventoryLocation] invLocation,
     [dbo].[tblLocationText] invLocationtxt
where partno.intInventoryID = parttxt.intInventoryID
  and partno.intInventoryTypeID = invType.intInventoryTypeID
  and partno.intInventoryID = invID.intInventoryID
  and parttxt.varLocaleID = invType.varLocaleID
  and partno.intInventoryID = invLocation.intInventoryID
  and invLocation.intLocationID = invLocationtxt.intLocationID 
  and partno.intCategoryID = categorytbl.intCategoryID
  and parttxt.varLocaleID = categorytbl.varLocaleID
  and partno.intSubCategoryID = subcategorytbl.intCategoryID
  and parttxt.varLocaleID = subcategorytbl.varLocaleID
  and partno.dteModifiedDate >= ''', activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.last_run_start_date,'''')

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat('select tranact.varTransactionNo as TransactionNo,							
       invLocationtxt.varLocationName as LocationName,							
       tranact.dteTransactionDate as TransactionDate,							
       usertxt.varFirstName as FirstName, usertxt.varLastName as LastName,
      entity.varEntityID as EntityId,				
       usertxt.varEmployeeNo as EmployeeNo,							
       crafttxt.varCraft as craft,	
       partno.varPartNo as partNo,							
       parttxt.varDescription as Description,							
       parttxt.varUserField1 as ident,							
       invID.varInventoryID as ItemID,							
       TranTyTx.varTransactionType as TransactionType, 			
       retStatTxt.varReturnStatus as varReturnStatus,						
       tranactDtl.intQty as Qty,							
       tranactDtl.decUnitCost as UnitCost, 							
       tranactDtl.decTotalCost as TotalCost,							
       tranactDtl.dteDueDateTime as DueDate,						
       jobtxt.varJobNumber as Job,				
       subjobtxt.varsubJobNumber as SubJob,					
       costcodetxt.varCostcodeNumber as CostCode,					
       costcodetxt.varCostCode as CostCodeDesc,							
      					
       tranact.varReference as Reference					
from [dbo].[tblTransaction] tranact							
  inner join [dbo].[tblLocationText] invLocationtxt on tranact.intLocationID = invLocationtxt.intLocationID							
  inner join [dbo].[tblTransactionDetail] tranactDtl on tranact.intTransactionID = tranactDtl.intTransactionID							
  inner join [dbo].[tblInventoryID] invID on tranactDtl.intInventoryIdID = invID.intInventoryIdID							
  inner join [dbo].[tblInventory] partno on  invID.intInventoryID = partno.intInventoryID 							
  inner join [dbo].[tblInventoryText] parttxt on parttxt.intInventoryID = partno.intInventoryID							
  inner join [dbo].[tblTransactionTypeText] TranTyTx on parttxt.varLocaleID = TranTyTx.varLocaleID  and tranactDtl.intTransactionTypeID = TranTyTx.intTransactionTypeID							
  inner join [dbo].[tblPersonnel] puser on tranact.intCreatedUserID = puser.intPersonnelID							
  inner join [dbo].[tblPersonnelText] usertxt on tranact.intCreatedUserID = usertxt.intPersonnelID							
  left join [dbo].[tblCraftText] crafttxt on parttxt.varlocaleID = crafttxt.VarLocaleID and puser.intCraftID = crafttxt.intCraftID							
  left join [dbo].[tblReturnStatusText] retStatTxt on parttxt.varlocaleID = retStatTxt.VarLocaleID and tranactDtl.intReturnStatusID = retStatTxt.intReturnStatusID							
  left join [dbo].[tblJobtext] jobtxt on parttxt.varlocaleID = jobtxt.VarLocaleID and tranact.intJobID = jobtxt.intJobID							
  left join [dbo].[tblSubJobtext] subjobtxt on parttxt.varlocaleID = subjobtxt.VarLocaleID and tranact.intsubJobID = subjobtxt.intsubJobID							
  left join [dbo].[tblCostCodeText] costcodetxt on parttxt.varlocaleID = costcodetxt.VarLocaleID and tranact.intCostCodeID = costcodetxt.intCostCodeID							
  left join [dbo].[tblEntity] entity on tranact.intEntityID = entity.intEntityID							
							
where tranact.dteModifiedDate >= ''', activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.last_run_start_date,'''')

Select DISTINCT 
 case when spmpo.ProjectDescription IS NULL THEN  ltrim(rtrim([PO_NUMBER]))
ELSE ltrim(rtrim(PO_NUMBER)) + '-00' END PO_NUMBER
 ,  ([POLI_POS]  + CAST([POLI_SUB_POS] as float)/1000) * 1000 as LineNumber
FROM [Staging].[SPMPurchaseOrderVendorDelivery] spmpovd
left join Conforming.SPMPO spmpo
on spmpovd.PROJ_ID = spmpo.ProjectId
where  PROJ_ID <> 'US017' 
AND JDE_SUPPLIER_NUMBER <> 'No Need'

query.value:
SELECT distinct
	'NA' AS PROJ_ID,
	Table__3.MCDL01 AS PROJECT_DESCRIPTION,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDOMCU AS JDE_PROJ_NUMBER,
	Table__3.MCRP03 AS OPERATING_GROUP,
	'NA' AS SECTOR,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDMCU AS Client,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDAN8 AS JDE_SUPPLIER_NUMBER,
    PDAN8.ABALPH AS SUPPLIER_NAME,
    CBIDTA.F4311.PDITM AS IDENT,
    CBIDTA.F4311.PDURRF AS TAG_NUMBER,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDDSC1 AS Description,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDDOCO AS PO_NUMBER,
	'NA' AS SPM_POH_ID,
	'NA' AS SUPPLEMENT,
	'NA' AS SUP_POH_ID,
	'NA' AS POLI_POS,
	'NA' AS POLI_SUB_POS,
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRNLIN AS ITEM_SHIP_POS,
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRALIN/1000 AS ITEM_SHIP_SUB_POS,
    'NA' AS FREIGHT_TERM,
    CASE WHEN CBIDTA.F4311.PDUORG = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CBIDTA.F4311.PDUORG / DDF('UORG') END AS POLI_QTY,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDUOM3 AS UOM,
	CJDEDTGD(CBIDTA.F4311.PDPDDJ) AS ISH_PROM_CONTRACT_DATE,
    CJDEDTGD(CBIDTA.F43121.PRRCDJ) AS MATL_RECV_DATE,
    'NA' AS ISH_ITEM_SHIP_QTY,  
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRUREC/1000 AS RECV_QTY,    
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRDCT AS RECV_TYPE,
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRDOC AS RECV_DOC_NUMBER, 
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDDOCO AS JDE_PO_NUMBER,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDLNID/1000 AS JDE_PO_LINE,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDDCTO AS ORDER_TYPE,
	CASE WHEN LENGTH(CBIDTA.F4311.PDSFXO) = 0 THEN '000' ELSE CBIDTA.F4311.PDSFXO END AS ORDER_SUFFIX,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDCO AS ACCOUNT_COMPANY,
	CBIDTA.F4301.PHKCOO AS ORDER_COMPANY,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDVR01 SPM_PO_NUMBER,
	CBIDTA.F43121.PRDOC AS SORId,
	'E1.CBIDTA.F43121.PRDOC' as SystemOfRecord
FROM
  ( 
  SELECT  aban8, alan8, abeftb, aleftb, abdc, abalph, aladd1, aladd2, aladd3, aladd4, aladdz, alcty1, alcoun, aladds, alctr, abac27
FROM CBIDTA.f0101, CBIDTA.f0116
WHERE aban8 = alan8
and    abeftb = aleftb
  ) AS PHANBY RIGHT OUTER JOIN CBIDTA.F4301 ON (PHANBY.ABAN8=CBIDTA.F4301.PHANBY)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN CBIDTA.F4311 ON (CBIDTA.F4301.PHDOCO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDDOCO AND CBIDTA.F4301.PHDCTO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDDCTO AND CBIDTA.F4301.PHKCOO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDKCOO)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN CBIDTA.F0006  Table__20 ON (Table__20.MCMCU=CBIDTA.F4311.PDOMCU)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ( 
  SELECT  aban8, alan8, abeftb, aleftb, abdc, abalph, aladd1, aladd2, aladd3, aladd4, aladdz, alcty1, alcoun, aladds, alctr, abac27
FROM CBIDTA.f0101, CBIDTA.f0116
WHERE aban8 = alan8
and    abeftb = aleftb
  ) AS PDAN8 ON (PDAN8.ABAN8=CBIDTA.F4311.PDAN8)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN CBIDTA.F43121 ON (CBIDTA.F43121.PRKCOO = CBIDTA.F4301.PHKCOO  AND  CBIDTA.F43121.PRDCTO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDDCTO  AND  CBIDTA.F43121.PRSFXO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDSFXO  AND  CBIDTA.F43121.PRDOCO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDDOCO  AND  CBIDTA.F43121.PRLNID = CBIDTA.F4311.PDLNID)
   INNER JOIN CBIDTA.F0006  Table__19 ON (Table__19.MCMCU=CBIDTA.F4311.PDMCU)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ( 
  SELECT CCCO, MCMCU, MCMCUS, MCDL01, CCNAME, MCRP03, integer(POWER(10, INTEGER(CVCDEC))) AS CDIV 
FROM CBIDTA.F0006
INNER JOIN CBIDTA.F0010 ON MCCO = CCCO
INNER JOIN CBIDTA.F0013 on  CCCRCD = CVCRCD
  ) AS Table__3 ON (Table__3.MCMCU=CBIDTA.F4311.PDMCU)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ( 
SELECT * 
FROM CBIDTA.F0010
  ) AS PHKCOO ON (PHKCOO.CCCO=CBIDTA.F4301.PHKCOO)  
WHERE
  (
   CBIDTA.F4311.PDDCTO  IN  ( 'OS','OH','OG','OP'  )
   AND
   CBIDTA.F4311.PDLTTR  <>  '980'
   AND
   CJDEDTGD(CBIDTA.F4311.PDTRDJ)  >=  {d '2013-01-01'}
   AND
   CJDEDTGD(CBIDTA.F4311.PDDGL) BETWEEN DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY +1 DAY - 1 MONTH) AND DATE(CURRENT_DATE  -DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY)
   AND 
   CBIDTA.F4311.PDAN8 NOT IN ('1545782','248743','203756','3838634','4382000','790516','275469','388421','2718930','3893692','3032905','3895153','5411845','2435374','3838634','3712812','5906987','3838589','1509642','3899365','738021')
  )
  AND length(CJDEDTGD(CBIDTA.F43121.PRRCDJ)) > 0 
  AND CJDEDTGD(CBIDTA.F43121.PRRCDJ) between DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY +1 DAY - 1 MONTH) AND  DATE(CURRENT_DATE  -DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY)
  AND (CBIDTA.F43121.PRDCT = 'OV' OR CBIDTA.F43121.PRDCT IS NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT distinct
	'NA' AS PROJ_ID,
	Table__3.MCDL01 AS PROJECT_DESCRIPTION,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDOMCU AS JDE_PROJ_NUMBER,
	Table__3.MCRP03 AS OPERATING_GROUP,
	'NA' AS SECTOR,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDMCU AS Client,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDAN8 AS JDE_SUPPLIER_NUMBER,
    PDAN8.ABALPH AS SUPPLIER_NAME,
    CBIDTA.F4311.PDITM AS IDENT,
    CBIDTA.F4311.PDURRF AS TAG_NUMBER,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDDSC1 AS Description,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDDOCO AS PO_NUMBER,
	'NA' AS SPM_POH_ID,
	'NA' AS SUPPLEMENT,
	'NA' AS SUP_POH_ID,
	'NA' AS POLI_POS,
	'NA' AS POLI_SUB_POS,
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRNLIN AS ITEM_SHIP_POS,
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRALIN/1000 AS ITEM_SHIP_SUB_POS,
    'NA' AS FREIGHT_TERM,
    CASE WHEN CBIDTA.F4311.PDUORG = 0 THEN 0
		ELSE
			CBIDTA.F4311.PDUORG / DDF('UORG') 
	END AS POLI_QTY,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDUOM3 AS UOM,
	CJDEDTGD(CBIDTA.F4311.PDPDDJ) AS ISH_PROM_CONTRACT_DATE,
    CJDEDTGD(CBIDTA.F43121.PRRCDJ) AS MATL_RECV_DATE,
    'NA' AS ISH_ITEM_SHIP_QTY,  
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRUREC/1000 AS RECV_QTY,    
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRDCT AS RECV_TYPE,
    CBIDTA.F43121.PRDOC AS RECV_DOC_NUMBER, 
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDDOCO AS JDE_PO_NUMBER,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDLNID/1000 AS JDE_PO_LINE,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDDCTO AS ORDER_TYPE,
	CASE WHEN LENGTH(CBIDTA.F4311.PDSFXO) = 0 THEN '000' ELSE CBIDTA.F4311.PDSFXO END AS ORDER_SUFFIX,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDCO AS ACCOUNT_COMPANY,
	CBIDTA.F4301.PHKCOO AS ORDER_COMPANY,
	CBIDTA.F4311.PDVR01 SPM_PO_NUMBER,
	CBIDTA.F43121.PRDOC AS SORId,
	'E1.CBIDTA.F43121.PRDOC' as SystemOfRecord
FROM
  ( 
  SELECT  aban8, alan8, abeftb, aleftb, abdc, abalph, aladd1, aladd2, aladd3, aladd4, aladdz, alcty1, alcoun, aladds, alctr, abac27
FROM CBIDTA.f0101, CBIDTA.f0116
WHERE aban8 = alan8
and    abeftb = aleftb
  ) AS PHANBY RIGHT OUTER JOIN CBIDTA.F4301 ON (PHANBY.ABAN8=CBIDTA.F4301.PHANBY)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN CBIDTA.F4311 ON (CBIDTA.F4301.PHDOCO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDDOCO AND CBIDTA.F4301.PHDCTO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDDCTO AND CBIDTA.F4301.PHKCOO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDKCOO)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN CBIDTA.F0006  Table__20 ON (Table__20.MCMCU=CBIDTA.F4311.PDOMCU)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ( 
  SELECT  aban8, alan8, abeftb, aleftb, abdc, abalph, aladd1, aladd2, aladd3, aladd4, aladdz, alcty1, alcoun, aladds, alctr, abac27
FROM CBIDTA.f0101, CBIDTA.f0116
WHERE aban8 = alan8
and    abeftb = aleftb
  ) AS PDAN8 ON (PDAN8.ABAN8=CBIDTA.F4311.PDAN8)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN CBIDTA.F43121 ON (CBIDTA.F43121.PRKCOO = CBIDTA.F4301.PHKCOO  AND  CBIDTA.F43121.PRDCTO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDDCTO  AND  CBIDTA.F43121.PRSFXO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDSFXO  AND  CBIDTA.F43121.PRDOCO = CBIDTA.F4311.PDDOCO  AND  CBIDTA.F43121.PRLNID = CBIDTA.F4311.PDLNID)
   INNER JOIN CBIDTA.F0006  Table__19 ON (Table__19.MCMCU=CBIDTA.F4311.PDMCU)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ( 
  SELECT   CCCO, MCMCU, MCMCUS, MCDL01, CCNAME, MCRP03, integer(POWER(10, INTEGER(CVCDEC))) AS CDIV 
FROM CBIDTA.F0006
INNER JOIN CBIDTA.F0010 ON MCCO = CCCO
INNER JOIN CBIDTA.F0013 on  CCCRCD = CVCRCD
  ) AS Table__3 ON (Table__3.MCMCU=CBIDTA.F4311.PDMCU)
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ( 
  SELECT * 
FROM CBIDTA.F0010
  ) AS PHKCOO ON (PHKCOO.CCCO=CBIDTA.F4301.PHKCOO)
  INNER JOIN CBIADHOC.SPMPOTEMP spmtmp
  ON 
spmtmp.PONUMBER = CBIDTA.F4311.PDVR01
AND spmtmp.LINEID = CBIDTA.F4311.PDLNID

SELECT PROJ_ID, PROJECT_DESCRIPTION, JDE_PROJ_NUMBER, OPERATING_GROUP, SECTOR, Client, JDE_SUPPLIER_NUMBER, IDENT, Description, TAG_NUMBER, 
                         SUPPLIER_NAME, PO_NUMBER, SPM_POH_ID, SUPPLEMENT, SUP_POH_ID, POLI_POS, POLI_SUB_POS, ITEM_SHIP_POS, ITEM_SHIP_SUB_POS, 
                         FREIGHT_TERM, CAST(POLI_QTY as decimal(31,3)) as POLI_QTY, UOM, ISH_PROM_CONTRACT_DATE, MATL_RECV_DATE, ISH_ITEM_SHIP_QTY,
CAST(RECV_QTY as decimal(31,3)) as RECV_QTY, RECV_TYPE, RECV_DOC_NUMBER, 
                         JDE_PO_NUMBER, JDE_PO_LINE, ORDER_TYPE, ORDER_SUFFIX, ORDER_COMPANY, ACCOUNT_COMPANY
FROM [Logistics].[PurchaseOrderVendorDeliveryZycus]
where  BatchDate = (SELECT MAX(BatchDate) from [Logistics].[PurchaseOrderVendorDeliveryZycus])
AND LEN(PROJ_ID) > 0
ORDER BY PROJ_ID,MATL_RECV_DATE
